title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Early Termination Notice Signature and Fee
content:
A client ends its ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement early by e-signing the early termination notice awaiting its signature; the signature puts the notice on the agreement and invoices the early termination fee.

**Scope of the fee.** For the early termination fee of an early termination notice that the authorized contact signs on an agreement with exactly one early termination request awaiting signature, whose requested date is at least the tier's notice days in calendar days after the signing date and so is the later of the date the client asks for and the notice received date plus the notice days, and only for such a fee, the fee is the exit-fee schedule, invoiced on the date the signed notice takes effect on the agreement. Every other early termination fee remains under the base rule: the tier's early termination fee percentage of the per-seat rate, multiplied by the minimum-commitment floor seats and by the number of service months that begin after the termination effective date and on or before the term end date, rounded half up to the cent, invoiced on the date the notice takes effect on the agreement.

**The notice signed.** The notice signed is the agreement's early termination request awaiting the client's signature. Signing it marks the request signed, puts the notice on the agreement with the notice type early termination, the signing date as the notice received date and the request's effective date as the termination effective date, and invoices the fee. With no such request awaiting signature there is no notice to sign and no fee.

**Conditions on the agreement and its ledger.**
- An early termination notice is recorded only once the agreement's status is active.
- The early termination fee is fixed only after the agreement carries the term in force on the day the notice is signed, its term end date falling on or after that day.
- The early termination fee is not worked out until the ledger carries the monthly fee of every service month begun before the notice is signed.

Equivalently: while the agreement shows a status other than active, no early termination notice is recorded; while its term end date falls before the signing day, the fee is not fixed; and while any service month begun before the signing has no monthly fee on the ledger, the fee is not worked out.

## Invocation: `sign_early_termination_notice_6477ae2a`

**Capability.** Lets the client's authorized contact e-sign the early termination notice awaiting signature. The signature marks the early termination request signed and puts the notice on the ClearPath agreement it concerns: the agreement moves to notice given, with early termination as the notice type, today as the date the signed notice was received and the stated termination effective date. The early termination fee stated on the notice is invoiced today on a new invoice and added to what the agreement owes. On success the agreement shows the notice on file and the fee appears on the billing ledger.

**How it is invoked.** This is the client's own tool: the agent unlocks `sign_early_termination_notice_6477ae2a` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the client organisation's reference number, as read out by the agent from the client profile lookup | identifier |
| `managed_agreement_id` | the reference number of the ClearPath agreement the notice ends, as read out by the agent from the agreement lookup | identifier |
| `managed_request_id` | the reference number of the contract change request record (the early termination request awaiting signature), as read out by the agent from the change-request lookup | identifier |
| `termination_effective_date` | the date the termination takes effect as stated on the notice | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern business date) |
| `early_termination_fee_usd` | the early termination fee stated on the notice in US dollars | decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation string with the request reference and its new status (signed), the agreement reference, the notice received date and termination effective date (YYYY-MM-DD), the fee invoice number (INV- followed by 6 digits), the fee in US dollars with 2 decimals and the agreement's new balance due in US dollars with 2 decimals; it begins with "Early termination notice signed" when the notice is on file.
